comment: The public roadmap. `bun nv site --check roadmap` keeps it in step with the goal chain, and `bun nv site --roadmap` copies it into README.md. `internal` lists the goals that are not public work.

themes.title: A faster start in large projects
themes.text: The editor and the compiler read a large project faster. Reading a whole project costs about the same time as compiling it.

themes.title: A calmer editor
themes.text: The Novis themes for VS Code draw brackets in the text colour and use quieter colours for methods and variables. A new setting turns off the parameter-name hints.

themes.title: PDF edge cases
themes.text: `Novis\Pdf` gets a test for each kind of document that other HTML-to-PDF libraries render wrong, such as a table across pages. A render reports each CSS feature it does not support.
